definition.text: Man of the dart, the son of Enoch, and grandfather of Noah. He was the oldest man of whom we have any record, dying at the age of nine hundred and sixty-nine years, in the year of the Flood (Gen. 5:21-27; 1 Chr. 1:3).

lemmas.gloss: Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs
to live, whether literally or figuratively
lemmas.kjv: keep  alive, certainly, give  life, live
